                    r'\1([^ ]+)\2',

                search_expr = _re.sub(

                # For center-aligned: fill*(.+?)fill* → fill*([^ ]+)fill*
                search_expr = _re.sub(
                    r'([\\]?\ *)\(\.\+\?\)(\s+[\\]?\ *)',

                    search_expr
